correction: A watch note's idle read (no run, no input in PiG's inbox) and its WhenBusyReject submission are two steps, since PiG offers no submission that rejects on a waiting input: an input and a failed run between them can queue the note behind that input. It is a known limit, stated in the spec, not worked around.
